related.description: Markdown note-taking web application designed for simplicity
A self-hosted, database-less note taking web app that utilises a flat folder of markdown files for storage.
CLI and local web plain text note‑taking, bookmarking, and archiving with linking, tagging, filtering, search, Git versioning & syncing, Pan...
Capture first. Organize later. A local-first Markdown app that turns scattered records into clear notes with AI.
